body:
oxycodone / xanax
Man I tried snorting the tylenol free version of oxy and I gotta tell you guys, it's fucking bad ass.  It's like coke, well close, in my opinion.  I didn't expect the rush, when I take this orally I get kinda sleepy.  This is the polar opposite, I took some xanax to bring it down a little bit and right now I'm feeling like 10 million bucks ~ wide awake, pain free, and I've a nice body high without jitters.
This is great stuff, fuck oral meds, I'll take it like this for now on I'm thinking.
